target_claim: In the (R2) derivation the proof asserts, citing rank axiom (R6), that rho(X union {y}) <= rho(X) + rho({y}) - rho(X union {y}); the subtracted term should be rho(X intersect {y}). The written inequality (equivalently 2*rho(X union {y}) <= rho(X) + rho({y})) is false for legitimate rank functions satisfying R4-R6, so the cited step does not follow from R6.
